spans.s:
(ञि औ) ञि औलिप r. 6th cl. (-लिम्पति-ते)
1 To increase or add to.
2 To anoint, to smear, to plaster.

m. (-पः)
Smearing, plastering.
E.
लिप to smear, aff. क.

f. (-पिः-पी)
1 Writing in general, handwriting.
2 A writing, a written paper or book, &c.
3 Painting, drawing.
4 Smearing, anointing, plastering.
E.
लिप to spread (ink) Uṇādi aff. इन् with ङीप् optionally added, the radical vowel unchanged.

m. (-रः)
A scribe, a writer.
E.
लिपि writing, and कर who executes.

m. (-रः)
A scribe, a writer.
E.
लिपि writing, and कार who makes, from कृ to make, and अण् aff.; also with ट aff. लिपिकर.

f. (-का)
Writing or a writing.
E.
लिपि writing, कन् added, fem. form.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
One who can write.
E.
लिपि, and ज्ञ who knows.

f. (-ज्जा)
Implements or materials for writing.
E.
लिपि, सज्जा preparation.

Envenomed, spread or touched with any poisonous substance.
4 Embraced, united, connected with, &c.
5 Defiled or contaminated by.
6 Stained, soiled.
E.
लिप to smear, aff. क्त, or in the last sense ली to cling to, Uṇādi aff. त, with पुट् augment, and the radical vowel made short.

m. (-कः)
A poisoned arrow.
E.
लिप्त poisoned, कन् aff.

Vitiated, defiled.
E.
लिप to smear, क्तवतु aff.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
Having the hands stained or smeared.
E.
लिप्त, and हस्त the hand.

f. (-प्सा)
Wish, desire.
E.
लिप्स the desiderative form of लभ to get, (to wish to get,) aff. अङ् and टाप्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Coveted, desired.
E.
लिप्स to wish to obtain, क्त aff.

mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु)
Desirous, desiring, wishing, cupidinous.
E.
लिप्स desiderative of लभ, (see the last,) and उ aff.
